answer: Port scanning is a technique used in network service discovery where adversaries attempt to identify services running on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices. This process may reveal services that could be vulnerable to remote software exploitation. Common methods for acquiring this information include using port scans, vulnerability scans, and wordlist scans, often employing specific tools designed for these purposes [Source 3].

## ATT&CK adversary context


**Technique:** Network Service Discovery

Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation. Common methods to acquire this information include port, vulnerability, and/or wordlist scans using tools that are brought onto a system.(Citation: CISA AR21-126A FIVEHANDS May 2021)
